about: Saint-Hippolyte is a municipality in the Laurentians, Quebec, north of Montréal toward Saint-Jérôme—not a large city. Forest lakes, residential growth, and lower-Laurentian cottage country define this expanding exurban community. About 10,000 people live in Saint-Hippolyte.
